..description: pandas Python, Cython, and C/C++ data analysis library, built with Meson.

web.description: Static pandas project website built from Markdown and templates with pandas_web.py.

web/interactive_terminal.description: Independent browser-based pandas REPL built as a JupyterLite static application.

lint_config.rationale: Root Ruff and Cython lint hooks cover pandas and the Python website generator; the configuration-only JupyterLite REPL has no lint analyzer.

type_check.rationale: Mypy and Pyright configure pandas source only; website and JupyterLite code have no dedicated static type check.

formatter.rationale: Ruff-format, isort, Cython formatters, and Meson formatter cover library and website source; no formatter targets the JupyterLite JSON configuration.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: Root pre-commit hooks cover source in pandas and web and repository-wide text checks also cover JupyterLite configuration.

strict_typing.rationale: Mypy enables disallow_untyped_defs and related strict options for pandas, with documented overrides; other applications lack strict checking.

naming_consistency.rationale: Import alias conventions and pre-commit test-name checks enforce Python naming in library and website code; JupyterLite has no enforced naming rules.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: No complexity threshold or analyzer found; Ruff's too-many-branches, statements, and related PLR091x rules are explicitly ignored.

large_file_detection.rationale: No size or line-count hook, CI file-size gate, LFS rule, or file-size linter rule found.

dead_code_detection.rationale: Root pre-commit Vulture hook checks unreachable Python code in library and website source; REPL has no applicable detector.

duplicate_code_detection.rationale: No copy-paste detection tool or CI duplication gate found for any application.

code_modularization.rationale: Pre-commit scripts reject private functions and imports used across Python modules in pandas and web; no REPL boundary enforcement.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: No configured TODO/FIXME issue-link check, technical debt scanner, or Sonar quality gate found.

n_plus_one_detection.rationale: The library, static website, and browser REPL are not database-backed services with ORM query paths.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: Root README and AGENTS.md link to build guidance but do not provide an executable build command; commands are in contributing_environment.rst.

deps_pinned.rationale: Committed pixi.lock resolves development dependencies; CI action references are SHA-pinned.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: GitHub CLI is installed and gh auth status exits successfully; its credential output was suppressed.

automated_pr_review.rationale: Local workflows show checks, not generated review comments; repository AGENTS.md bars issue/PR-related interactions, so bot reviews were not inspected.

agentic_development.rationale: Recent Git history includes Claude Opus co-author trailers; AGENTS.md and the PR template define an AI contribution workflow.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: PR status-check durations were not accessed because AGENTS.md bars issue/PR-related interactions; local workflow definitions cannot prove under-10-minute feedback.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: CI has package caching and parallel jobs but no build-duration monitoring, dashboard, or build-time trend evidence.

deployment_frequency.rationale: The docs-and-web workflow publishes on main pushes; observed multiple successful push runs on October 28-29, 2026.

single_command_setup.rationale: Setup requires compiler, environment creation, and a separate Meson/Pixi build; no single fresh-clone setup command is documented.

feature_flag_infrastructure.rationale: No deployment feature flag service or rollout toggle system found.

release_notes_automation.rationale: Tag-triggered wheels workflow generates a draft GitHub release from templated notes; whatsnew entries feed release documentation.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Repository primarily builds a library and static sites, not deployment infrastructure with percentage-based service rollout.

rollback_automation.rationale: No independently operated service infrastructure is defined; automated rollback is not applicable to this source repository.

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Pixi workspace environments and separate CI build tasks coordinate library, website, and JupyterLite builds.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: No bundle size analyzer, size budget, or heavy-dependency report found; JupyterLite's unused shared-package option only optimizes output.

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: No deptry, pip-extra-reqs, or equivalent unused-dependency CI hook found. Version-sync checks do not detect unused dependencies.

version_drift_detection.rationale: Only one Python/Pixi build package is declared; website and REPL reuse its workspace rather than separate dependency modules.

release_automation.rationale: Tag-triggered workflow publishes packages and drafts releases; main-branch documentation workflow publishes the website.

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: Not applicable because no feature flag infrastructure was found.

unit_tests_exist.rationale: pandas/tests and web/tests contain pytest unit tests; JupyterLite configuration has no test suite.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: The library has SQL, network, and I/O integration tests; website tests exercise end-to-end static generation. REPL has no interaction tests.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: Direct collect-only on web/tests/test_pandas_web.py exited zero with five tests. Direct collect-only on pandas/tests/test_flags.py exited four: missing compiled pandas extension and incompatible local PyArrow/NumPy. REPL has no tests.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: Root pytest configuration reports the 30 slowest tests for pandas and website CI runs; REPL has no timed test suite.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: No retry plugin, quarantine, or stability tracking found locally; remote PR retries were not queried under AGENTS.md.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: Codecov receives library coverage, but project and patch status gates are explicitly off; no minimum coverage gate for any app.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: Pre-commit runs scripts.check_test_naming for pandas/tests; web tests follow pytest names without a configured naming gate, and REPL lacks tests.

test_isolation.rationale: pandas CI uses pytest-xdist parallel workers and web tests use per-test tmp_path fixtures; REPL has no test isolation checks.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: Contribution guide documents install/build/import for pandas; web README documents generation, local HTTP server, and viewing the site. REPL README omits serving and a concrete REPL interaction.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Library and website have complete documented local interaction paths, used as fallback without installing dependencies. REPL lacks a complete serve-and-drive path; pandas itself could not run here.

agents_md.rationale: Root AGENTS.md documents project map, development tooling, CI entry points, workflow constraints, and detailed guide links.

readme.rationale: Root README describes pandas, installation, dependencies, and source-install instructions via linked guide.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: Sphinx documentation and the website generator build and publish generated docs in docbuild-and-upload.yml.

skills.rationale: No repository SKILL.md files or configured agent skills directories found.

documentation_freshness.rationale: Git history records README.md or AGENTS.md edits in October 2026, within 180 days of the audit.

api_schema_docs.rationale: The three applications are a Python library and static browser sites, not HTTP API services.

service_flow_documented.rationale: No architecture diagram or dedicated service-dependency flow document found in the repository.

agents_md_validation.rationale: Monthly Lychee workflow scans Markdown links repository-wide, including AGENTS.md references; it reports broken links in an issue.

env_template.rationale: No .env.example or root README/AGENTS.md inventory of environment variables; website optionally uses GITHUB_TOKEN in source and CI.

local_services_setup.rationale: No local database or other required external service dependencies; website uses optional external public data during build.

database_schema.rationale: None of the applications owns a database schema; pandas can connect to user-managed databases as a library.

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: No devcontainer configuration or devcontainer CLI is available; a runnable container check is not applicable.

structured_logging.rationale: No structured logging dependency or dedicated application logger module configured for library, website, or REPL.

distributed_tracing.rationale: No request/trace ID propagation or distributed tracing instrumentation configured.

metrics_collection.rationale: ASV benchmarks and CI coverage exist, but no running application telemetry or metrics collection is configured.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: pandas CI uploads measured branch coverage to Codecov; website and REPL have no configured coverage or quality metrics.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: No Sentry, Bugsnag, or Rollbar setup with contextualized production errors found.

alerting_configured.rationale: CI opens an issue for persistent library nightly-build failures and for broken website links; REPL has no dedicated alert rule.

runbooks_documented.rationale: Maintainer guide covers releases and issue triage, but no incident-response runbook or runbook pointer found.

deployment_observability.rationale: No deployment-impact monitoring dashboard or deployment notification reference found for any application.

health_checks.rationale: The library needs no health endpoint; neither deployed static site defines a health route, probe, or load-balancer check.

circuit_breakers.rationale: Website generator falls back to cached production JSON when GitHub API returns 403; no resilience policy for REPL or library external calls.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: ASV measures benchmarks, but no profiler, flame-graph, or application profiling instrumentation is configured.

branch_protection.rationale: Authenticated GitHub CLI reports no repository admin permission; branch protection API validation was skipped as required.

secret_scanning.rationale: No local secret-scanner workflow found; native GitHub secret-scanning status requires admin access not granted to this CLI user.

codeowners.rationale: .github/CODEOWNERS assigns maintainers to CI, documentation, and library paths.

automated_security_review.rationale: Scheduled CodeQL Python/C++/Actions analyses and OpenSSF Scorecard publish readable code-scanning/SARIF security assessments.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: Dependabot updates GitHub Actions weekly; scheduled workflow creates a PR for refreshed pixi.lock.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: Gitignore covers builds, caches, IDE files, and .DS_Store, but does not exclude .env or .env.* files.

dast_scanning.rationale: No DAST workflow probes the running static website or browser REPL; the library is not a deployed web service.

pii_handling.rationale: These applications do not collect end-user data; generic pandas user data and public maintainer profiles are not an owned PII service.

privacy_compliance.rationale: Library and static sites do not collect end-user data; consent and deletion infrastructure is not applicable.

secrets_management.rationale: GitHub Actions injects tokens and deployment keys through secrets.* references instead of hardcoded credentials.

log_scrubbing.rationale: No configured log redaction, sanitization utility, or scrubbing guidance found.

min_release_age.rationale: Dependabot configuration sets cooldown.default-days: 7, delaying action dependency updates.

issue_templates.rationale: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE contains structured bug, feature, documentation, installation, and performance templates.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: Templates label issue types and triage state, but no consistent priority and area label taxonomy was found.

backlog_health.rationale: Open-issue sampling was not performed because AGENTS.md bars issue/PR-related interactions; local files cannot establish backlog health.

pr_templates.rationale: PR template is a checklist for tests, checks, release notes, and AI disclosure, but lacks description and context sections.

product_analytics_instrumentation.rationale: No Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Heap, or GA4 instrumentation found.

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: Nightly wheel failures and documentation link-check errors automatically create or update GitHub issues; REPL has no error-to-issue integration.
